mapper.select: SELECT * FROM campaign WHERE id = #{campain_id} AND is_deleted = 'false'
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = 'SYSTEM' WHERE id = #{campain_id} AND is_deleted = 'false' AND status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
mapper.delete: UPDATE campaign SET is_deleted = 'true', updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = 'SYSTEM' WHERE id = #{campain_id} AND is_deleted = 'false' AND status IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL', 'REJECTED')
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, CONCAT('CMP-', c.id) AS code, c.name AS name, c.description AS description, c.start_time AS startTime, c.end_time AS endTime, c.status AS status, c.discount AS discount, COALESCE(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.name ORDER BY p.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM campain_product cp INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = cp.product_id WHERE cp.campaign_id = c.id AND cp.is_deleted = 'false' AND p.is_deleted = 'false' ), '') AS products FROM campaign c WHERE c.is_deleted = 'false' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaign ( created_at, created_by, is_deleted, status, discount, end_time, name, start_time, total_stock, product_id, description ) VALUES ( #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{isDeleted}, #{status}, #{discount}, #{endTime}, #{name}, #{startTime}, #{totalStock}, #{productId}, #{description} )
